notes.title: Small Patch Update 2
notes.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468853/98d8f86987d51ae6c82122e81acd6d1f36e641db.pngUpdated the Image Clarity and Color Accuracy of Captured Desktop, Along with Partial UI Updates, Now You Can Capture the Desktop to Watch Movies or Similar Activities, or You Can Use It for Some Work Tasks（更新了捕获桌面的图像清晰度和色彩准确度，以及部分的UI更新，现在你可以捕获桌面用来看电影之类的了，或者你可以使用它进行一些工作）

notes.title: Small Patch Update
notes.content: Now you can simply press the A button on the controller to generate your screen.（现在你可以直接点击手柄上的A键一键生成你的屏幕）
